items.hypothesis: Price repeatedly entering a previously observed price band and rapidly reclaiming/rejecting it, with abnormal traded volume and opposing aggressor flow, may identify conditional mean-reversion/failed-breakout edges.
prerequisites: Continuous 1m OHLCV and takerBuyQuote/base history for SOLUSDT, XRPUSDT, ETHUSDT and BTCUSDT.
Recorded aggTrade and depth@100ms streams with sequence integrity, timestamps and book-resync status; distinguish wall absorption from wall pulling.
Training-only price-bin/zone-width and volume/ATR thresholds; tick-size and contract metadata.
Node >=24/npm >=11, local checkout, deterministic 1m-to-5m/15m/1h/4h aggregation tests.

detectorPlan.zoneConstruction: Build candidate bands from repeated reaction anchors and/or aggTrade volume-at-price clusters. Fit bin width and merge tolerance on training data only; compare an OHLCV pivot-only baseline against trade-volume and book-aware variants.
detectorPlan.rejectionEvent: After price enters or sweeps a zone, require a completed 1m close to reclaim the predeclared boundary within a frozen number of minutes; require training-derived abnormal-volume threshold. Full absorption variant additionally requires opposing aggressor delta while displayed liquidity persists and executes; classify pulled walls separately.
detectorPlan.multiTimeframe: Construct 5m/15m/1h/4h candles from the same contiguous 1m stream: first open, max high, min low, last close, sum base/quote volume and trades, sum taker-buy quantities/notional. Mark a higher candle incomplete if any constituent minute is missing; cross-check completed aggregates against native Binance klines.
detectorPlan.outcomes: After confirmation close, evaluate 1m/5m entry with 5/15/30/60m horizons; target-before-stop, MFE/MAE, net bps/R after taker fees, spread, slippage and funding. Use chronological train/validation/untouched test, purging, block bootstrap and Holm correction.
detectorPlan.controls: Separate OHLCV-only, taker-flow, and full order-book variants; compare against random-entry and simple range-fade baselines; no lookahead from forming bars; NO_TRADE on missing constituents, stale book, or insufficient evidence.
